attributes.action: Prepare retaliatory trade actions if any country undermines Falkland sovereignty
attributes.additional_details:
We call on the Government to prepare contingencies for any foreign action undermining Falkland Islands self-determination, including:
✓ New Big Tech regulations in event of politicised map-label changes
✓ proportionate diplomatic/territorial countermeasures in response to diplomatic threats
✓ guidance for the hospitality sector on wine, liquor and cola procurement (akin to the delisting of Russian vodkas)
✓ market restrictions where foreign actions appear to legitimise coercion or aggression.
attributes.background: Petition the Government to develop a contingency framework of diplomatic, trade, procurement/import measures that could be implemented in response to any official foreign action that undermines the sovereignty of the Falklands or the right of Islanders to self-determination, to act as a deterrent.

rejection.details:
Some measures are already being taken by the Government, as set out in this oral statement delivered in the House of Commons on 13 October 2026: https://commonsbusiness.parliament.uk/Document/108076/Pdf?subType=Standard 

We were unclear what was meant by "official foreign action that undermines the sovereignty of the Falklands or the right of Islanders to self-determination" relative to what is already the stance of some countries.

You could start a new petition setting out more clearly what you would like to see and how this is different to what the Government is already doing.
